_instructions: Managed from the admin page. To edit by hand: put the image in this folder and add an entry to 'promos'. Fields: title, type ('product' | 'store' | 'news'), image (filename in this folder or full https:// URL), date ('YYYY-MM-DD', posting date), text, cta (optional button label), validFrom / validUntil (optional 'YYYY-MM-DD'; the promo is hidden outside these dates). Newest first; the 2 newest active promos also appear on the home page. Only post real, current offers.
